newsitem.title: USA: RJR Nabisco sets $200 mln share buyback.
newsitem.headline: RJR Nabisco sets $200 mln share buyback.

text.p: RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp said Friday its board had authorized up to $200 million for its share repurchase program in 1997, double the amount authorized for share repurchases last year.
RJR Nabisco also said the board had voted to change the record date for the annual meeting of shareholders to March 10 from March 3.
The company said it changed the record date to allow new holders of the 20 million shares formerly held by Carl Ichan to vote at the meeting.
The annual meeting is scheduled for April 16.
RJR Nabisco said the board's authorization of up to $200 million of stock repurchases was part of a 10-million-share repurchase objective set by the board in 1996.
It said the repurchase objective is tied to the realization of the company's operating plans over several years.
As the first step in that program, in 1996 the board authorized the repurchase of up to $100 million of stock in the open market. The company bought back about 3.3 million shares during the year.
